utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Dane, I’m happy to help with the carpool—what days and times are we covering?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — I usually need help on weekdays, around 8:00 a.m. and again about 5:30 p.m. if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, that can work for me on weekdays. I can cover the 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. rides to start.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time should I be ready for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you be ready by 7:20? I just want to double-check the pickup time before I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, 7:20 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep track of who’s bringing what for the carpool. Just tell me the pickup list and I’ll make sure we’ve got everything covered.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — I’m a bit scattered, so that’d really help. I’ll send you the pickup list in a minute.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No problem — send it over when you’re ready, and I’ll keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, sure—what time were you thinking for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Maybe around 7:30? I just want to make sure we have enough time and won’t be rushing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 7:30 sounds good to me. We can leave a little early if you want, just to be safe.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do we still have room for one more in the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m pretty sure we do, but I only heard that second-hand. Let me check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks—please let me know once you’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’m just checking who’s in for the carpool this week—want me to keep you posted if anything changes?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, please do—just keep me in the loop and I can help if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Gus—I’ll keep you posted if anyone drops out or if the plan shifts.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, I’m putting together the carpool list now—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes please—save me a spot. I’m at 14 Cedar Lane, and I can leave by 8:10.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I've got you down for 14 Cedar Lane, leaving at 8:10.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What time and where should I be?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’re still good for 7:30 by the front gate?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, 7:30 by the front gate still works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo — I’m just getting the carpool organized for the block. What timing works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Morning works best for me — around 8:00 is ideal.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll pencil you in for around 8:00 and keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can repeat the carpool plan to everyone and make sure it’s clear.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would be a big help, Vik. Let’s keep it simple so everyone knows the pickup time and place.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll tell everyone the pickup time and place, and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the carpool — I think I’m in, unless I already promised someone else and forgot. What time were we doing it again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think we said 7:30, but I can double-check if you want.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: 7:30 sounds right to me — thanks, please double-check if you can so I don’t mix it up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, I’m happy to help sort out the carpool—who needs a ride and what time are we aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — I think Maya and Ben need rides, and we’re aiming for around 7:30 in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I can take Maya and Ben at 7:30. I’ll check in about pickup spots and make sure everyone’s set.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I’m putting together the carpool—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, please save me a spot—I might be a little late again.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No problem—I’ll save you a spot and leave a little wiggle room. Just text me when you’re on your way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Eli, I’m happy to help with the carpool. What days are you thinking about?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey — that’s kind of you. I was thinking Mondays and Wednesdays, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mondays and Wednesdays work for me. Just let me know the pickup time and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do carpool this week if we can line up the school drop-off times. What days are you thinking, Mara?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works for me — I was thinking Monday through Thursday for drop-off. If you send me the times, I’ll line everything up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll send you our drop-off times tonight so we can line up Monday through Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik — I can help line up the carpool and keep everyone in the loop. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules — I was thinking around 7:30, and I’ll tell everyone once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — 7:30 works for me. Just send me the final list, and I’ll help keep everyone updated.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Pia — I can lend a hand with the carpool if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot, Gus — I just want to make sure the timing and stops are all lined up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — send me the timing and the stop list, and I’ll help get it lined up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the pickup spot and time for the carpool—just tell me the details and I’ll note them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I’ll send you the pickup spot and time as soon as I confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good—once you have them, I’ll write down the pickup spot and time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, are we still on for the carpool tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, we should be—can you remind me what time and where we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — let’s meet at 8:15 by the apartment entrance like last time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What time and day are we looking at?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — it’s for Tuesday morning, around 7:30. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — Tuesday at 7:30 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m a little behind — what’s the latest on the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think it’s still on for the usual time, but I may have missed if anything changed. I can check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d help — I’m still a bit out of the loop, so just let me know if the time changed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Tess — are we still doing the carpool tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, we’re still on for tomorrow morning. I’ll swing by right on time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just confirming — what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, hey Uli — did the carpool time stay the same? I’m happy to help if you still need a seat filled.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, the time’s still the same. If you’re still able to help, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I can help fill the seat. Just send me the pickup details and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the carpool. I’m happy to help; just remind me what time you wanted to leave.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s leave at 7:30 if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: 7:30 works for me — thanks for reminding me. I’ll be ready then.
